zh: 首页内嵌打开的内置功能页与自定义工具页现在会实时跟随全局中英文切换（含内嵌工具栏标题、按钮提示及深层嵌套页面）。
在新标签页或独立窗口打开的工具页面（除已有原生语言开关的页面外）统一在右侧边下部提供语言切换抽屉按钮，切换后实时生效并与平台同步。
en: Built-in pages and custom tools embedded inside the home shell now switch languages in real time along with the global language toggle, including the embedded frame toolbar and nested tool frames.

Standalone tool pages opened in a new tab or window (when no native language toggle is already present) now show a unified right-edge lower language switch drawer button that syncs across the platform.
